content:
incident-bot: 🔔 Paging: P0 elevated 5xx + streaming disconnects observed across gateway clusters (us-west/us-east). Error surge detected starting ~02:20 UTC. oncall: @maya (primary)
maya (oncall): ack. seeing errors in dashboard. can you paste the top error samples? what customers impacted? :thinking:
incident-bot: Top error signatures (sample):\n- `HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable` upstream: connection reset by peer
- `chunked encoding: premature EOF`\n- `client canceled request` during streaming frames
- 502 from gateway when fanout > 20

sre-sam: adding logs from gateway (tail):\n```
2026-03-15T02:21:05Z gateway[router-1]: upstream error: write to socket: broken pipe
2026-03-15T02:21:06Z gateway[router-3]: stream: chunked trailer missing; closing connection
2026-03-15T02:21:09Z gateway[router-2]: client cancelled stream (ECONNRESET)
```
jonathan: Customer-impact check: CS noted elevated errors for 3 orgs on hosted API (alpha-fin, noteable, chatapp-co). CS @customer-success-anna says some user sessions dropped and a few timed out during long streaming replies.
customer-success-anna: confirmed — about 120 sessions failed in last 15m, intermittent. Some customers report partial outputs then disconnect. They see 5xx in console.
maya (oncall): initial triage: appears correlated with a routing push at 02:14 UTC that redistributed traffic to new fanout policy. could be overload on a subset of routers. trying quick mitigation: revert routing for fanout>10 to previous policy.
maya (oncall): running rollback: `deploy-bot rollback routing-config 2026-03-15_0212 --target=gateway-cluster` — will update when done. :gear:
deploy-bot: rollback started for routing-config 2026-03-15_0212 -> progressing. expected completion ~30s.
eng-runtime-lee: ping — we also saw increased KV-cache misses which amplify token work. logs show spike in model host latency at 02:15 UTC. suspect combined effect: routing change + cache churn.
sre-sam: running `kubectl -n gateway logs -l app=gateway -c router | grep -i "chunked" | tail -n 50` to fetch more context. copying hits.
sre-sam: additional snippet:\n```
... router-3 ... fanout=18 tokens=~400 queue=22ms upstream-latency=120ms -> 502
... router-1 ... fanout=4 tokens=~800 upstream write error: broken pipe
```
maya (oncall): mitigation plan (live):\n- rollback routing change (in progress)\n- raise gateway streaming timeout from 30s -> 90s for affected routes (temp)\n- enable keepalive pings for streaming proxies\n- enable streaming fallback: route clients to non-chunked paged endpoint when chunked fails\n- page runtime oncall & eng-runtime to investigate model host stalls
jonathan: I'll take runtime oncall after you, @eng-runtime-lee can you shadow? I want model-team context for cache churn and socket resets.
eng-runtime-lee: on it. looking at model host metrics now. seeing GC spikes on a subset of hosts around 02:16 UTC. collecting heap/GC logs.
sre-sam: rollback completed. deploy-bot reports config reverted to previous fanout policy. early telemetry: 5xx count down ~38% in last 2m.
deploy-bot: rollback finished successfully for routing-config 2026-03-15_0212.
maya (oncall): applying temporary gateway tweak: `infractl set gateway.timeout.stream 90s --scope=usc-*` — applied to us clusters. will monitor.
eng-runtime-lee: started live debug on model hosts: `ssh model-heap-12` -> pulled `jstat` and GC log. evidence of a background compaction loop on model host 12 causing 200-800ms tail latency spikes.
jonathan: good catch. mitigation option: spin up additional warm standby model hosts and shift traffic off the noisy instance. can we autoscale quickly?
eng-runtime-lee: can scale + warm cache with `runtime-scale --group=model-prod-a --add=4 --prewarm=true`. kicking it now.
sre-sam: noticed a pattern: client cancels typically follow a ~60s inactivity window — likely client-side timeout + server-side stall. increasing keepalive will reduce clients canceling mid-stream.
customer-success-anna: CS team posting templated status to affected customers: brief note that we're investigating, mitigation steps underway and we expect partial restoration within 10-20m. please ping when we have clear rollback/restore.
maya (oncall): scaling run started. also enabling streaming keepalive on proxies: `proxyctl set keepalive 15s` — applied.
eng-runtime-lee: prewarm tasks started; new hosts registering with runtime. warming KV-cache with high-frequency prompt set.
sre-sam: after keepalive + timeout increase we see client-cancel events drop ~70% in the last 3m. overall 5xx trending down but still some tail errors on longer streams.
jonathan: handing off to me for next 30m to watch runtime and customer impact. @maya you can go to rest. summary for handoff: rollback done, gateway timeouts increased, keepalive enabled, runtime scaling + prewarm in progress, affected customers notified. paging me if any regression. :white_check_mark:
maya (oncall): thanks — leaving notes in incident tracker. pasting quick command list for handoff: \n- `observability query errors:service=gateway | since 10m`\n- `runtime inspect hosts --latency > 200ms`\n- `tail -f /var/log/gateway/router-*.log | grep chunked`\n
jonathan: will keep monitoring. eng-runtime-lee, if you confirm the GC compaction patch or host replace is needed, escalate and I'll approve.
eng-runtime-lee: replacing model-heap-12 with fresh instance, patching runtime to avoid aggressive compaction threshold. rolling restart scheduled in 10m window.
incident-bot: NOTE: escalation policy triggered -> paging runtime oncall (jonathan). Pager event id: PAGER-2026-03-15-4421
jonathan: acknowledged pager. I have the handoff. continuing triage, will post updates every 5-10m or on any customer-impact change. :phone:
customer-success-anna: will update customers: round 1 note sent. will send follow-up if errors drop under 1% for 10m.
sre-sam: final quick note: we saw some malformed chunked trailers on a small fraction of requests. adding a temporary validator reject rule upstream to drop those early (prevents backend work). applying now.
maya (oncall): thanks everyone. leaving channel. good mitigation steps. :pray:
jonathan: thanks team — continuing monitoring. next update in ~8m unless something changes"
